source: RI-CRM02 §1-§8. The Morag Tong problem and its answer.
ruling: Legality is jurisdictional and partial. No authority in Argonia can make a killing lawful everywhere, because no authority in Argonia holds everywhere. A writ is a document that some people honour.

authorities.name: The Morag Tong
authorities.price: You become an asset of a Morrowind institution in a province that hates Morrowind

authorities.name: The Imperial Provincial Office
authorities.price: Legion/Provincial rank >= 4; each warrant costs 1 rank-progress and is logged
authorities.expiry_effect: recalled; the target learns your name

authorities.name: A ku-vastei (Shadowscale arbiter, CF-029)
authorities.effect_in_interior: extinguishes the blood-price the killing would create, and any existing blood-price on the same family
authorities.price: the shadowscale-claim (RI-CHR03) or a rootkeeper petition costing 3,000 g and a quest

authorities.name: The Wet Ledger
authorities.instrument: no writ - it buys the report chain
authorities.price: Ledger rank >= 3, and a favour owed that the Ledger calls in later, at a time it chooses

writ_never_does.note: They still see you, still flee, still report. The report simply resolves as lawful. The same witness who cleared you of murder also saw you pick the lock on the way in, and THAT report is not covered.
Guards who intervene, a bystander caught by a sweeping greatsword, the dog. RI-CRM01's schedule applies in full.
Void the moment you cross into a settlement or interior jurisdiction, and 4 of the 14 warrant targets LIVE in one.
Disposition, faction standing, blood-price and rumour all move as if you had murdered somebody, because you did.
An unexecuted Warrant held past 14 in-game days is recalled, costs 1 further rank-progress, and the target learns your name.

kill_yielded_target.condition: if any witness saw the yield
kill_yielded_target.note: the one place the corpus prices HOW a killing was performed

spared_shapes.what: The target pays you more than the writ does
spared_shapes.faction_cost: quest failed; -1 rank-progress; the target owes you a favour that 3 quests read

spared_shapes.what: You escort them out of the jurisdiction and they never return
A document, a confession or a public ruin achieves the result

spared_shapes.faction_cost: -2 rank-progress; the authority sends someone else, and that someone is a named NPC who SUCCEEDS, visibly, three quests later

exclusivity.why: The Legion does not commission the assets of a foreign House
The Deep-Kin position is that the coast is a wound
The Ledger's business survives on not being either
A ku-vastei will not rule for a Tong asset

The Ledger's product is that no report is ever made. A ku-vastei Ruling is a public record of the killing, spoken aloud to a family. The two are not merely incompatible services, they are opposite ones, and the Ledger will not pay for a silence you intend to break.
exclusivity.provenance: ADDED BY W1-15. RI-CRM02 §8's census asserts max_simultaneous_authorities = 2 and §4's exclusivity table permits THREE: Warrant (ninth-cohort>=4) + Ledger (wet-ledger>=3) + a ku-vastei petition, with no row forbidding any of the three pairs. The probe found it by exhaustive search over the join graph (tools/harness/stl-probe.mjs, CRM02-M5b). The census is the design claim the item is scored on, so one further exclusion is required; this is the one whose in-fiction reason falls out of the two institutions' own products. AMENDMENT-W1-15-01 §2 records it.

standing_ids._note: W1-FACTIONS r2. The map between the quest book's faction ids and the standing keys standingKey() tests. It lives here, in data, rather than in sim/crime/sanction.js, because a restated faction list is how three ladders came to favour an attribute (`intelligence`) that this game does not have. Engine.syncFactionStandings() reads it every step; without it, sim.stealth.p.standings had exactly one writer in the whole build and that writer was a harness method.

interception.effect: report kind:intercepted, bounty 0, a favour_owed flag
interception.on_refusal: kind:unlawful, full bounty, a spoken refusal

interception.effect: guards accept a verbal account: one crime per in-game week dismissed at the arrest interaction without gold; the faction-invocation topic is always present
no report is possible - there is no one to report to. But BLOOD-PRICE STILL ACCRUES, and Deep-Kin membership does not reduce it.
interception.note: Being one of them is not being above them.

interception.effect: Dres and Dunmer witnesses (RG-DRES) do not report you FOR KILLING DUNMER. They report everything else.

hunters.who: 2 named Legion DUELISTs, a Warrant of Attainder against you

hunters.trigger: expulsion from the Ninth Cohort at rank >= 5
hunters.note: nothing, deliberately - the Legion writes you off, and that absence is the point
